Description.Name: Lumen Furey
Description.Details: Star Captain Lumen Furey, along with her trothkin Lukas Furey both chose to receive Enhanced Imaging Neural Implants. This process made Lumen a force to be reckoned with on the battlefield, and it took the combined efforts of multiple 'Mechs to defeat her in combat. Her indenture as a bondswoman has not dulled her abilities, which have earned her the callsign "Tornado".
